entries.title: Fold a card's thread back into the card
entries.body: Collapse thread, at the top of a card's thread, folds it back into the card, and ⌘\ does the same. The newest message and the count sit above the reply box: click them, or press ⌘\ again, to open the thread beside the card. A new message opens it on its own.

picture.alt: A card with its thread folded in: the newest message and the message count sit above the reply box.
